items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Harry came in 1927 and Johnny came in 1928, and I came in 1929.

ctx.x: Harry came in 1927 and Johnny came in 1928, and I came in 1929.

Is that right? Well, cause I always think of -- always thought of Harry as, you know, he was so modest and young looking and acting and everything. I mean, he didn't throw his weight around at all, did he?
